info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Healthcare Appointments Notes-v3-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointments Notes Retrieval API allows healthcare providers to access comprehensive notes associated with patient appointments. This API serves as a critical resource for clinicians looking to review patient history and treatment information efficiently. It enables authorized users, such as healthcare professionals and administrative staff, to retrieve detailed notes that enhance care coordination and decision-making. Ideal for integration into healthcare applications, this API supports enhanced patient management and continuity of care.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch all notes linked to appointments, providing valuable context and details that enhance the overall appointment information.

requestBody.description: Retrieve a collection of notes related to appointments. This request allows clients to obtain specific appointment notes based on defined criteria.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of appointment notes.

ListHealthcareAppointmentsNotesRequest.description: A string representation for the request body used in the GET operation for appointments notes.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the appointment note.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information regarding the creation and modification of the appointment note.

ListHealthcareAppointmentsNotesResponse_.description: Response schema for the GET operation on appointments notes. Contains the result status, reference number, processing time, and audit details.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the appointment note.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment note was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the appointment note was created automatically by a system.

Audit.description: Audit information for tracking the creation and modification of the appointment.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time in milliseconds that the server took to process the request. Useful for performance monitoring.
